g.text: U10 PCF8563T at I2C address 0x51 on I2C0. It keeps time down to 1.0 V.

g.desc: U10 PCF8563T at I2C address 0x51 on I2C0. It keeps time down to 1.0 V.

g.text: D10 and D11 are silicon diodes, not Schottky: a Schottky leaks as much as the RTC draws.

g.desc: D10 and D11 are silicon diodes, not Schottky: a Schottky leaks as much as the RTC draws.

g.text: VDD_RTC is about 2.7 V from 3V3 and 2.6 V from the cell. R59 limits the current into the

g.desc: VDD_RTC is about 2.7 V from 3V3 and 2.6 V from the cell. R59 limits the current into the

g.text: cell to under 1 mA if D11 fails short.

g.desc: cell to under 1 mA if D11 fails short.

g.text: Y1 32.768 kHz, 12.5 pF. C36 18 pF with the 25 pF inside OSCO gives an 11.7 pF load.

g.desc: Y1 32.768 kHz, 12.5 pF. C36 18 pF with the 25 pF inside OSCO gives an 11.7 pF load.

g.text: CLKO is not used: firmware writes 0x00 to register 0x0D to turn the 32 kHz output off.

g.desc: CLKO is not used: firmware writes 0x00 to register 0x0D to turn the 32 kHz output off.

g.text: BT1 holds a CR2032, fitted at final assembly. Back-up current 0.25 uA typical: about ten years.

g.desc: BT1 holds a CR2032, fitted at final assembly. Back-up current 0.25 uA typical: about ten years.
